close_reason: Fixed by commits 2761dea (add jmap_types::methods module) + 4bf3a25 (migrate 7 client crates). SetError now has all 8 RFC 8620 §5.3 fields plus a serde-flatten 'extra' map for extension fields. The 5 response shapes are defined once in jmap-types and re-exported by all 7 jmap-*-client crates. Net -697 LOC across the client crates. 1424 workspace tests pass.
description:
All 7 client crates' `pub struct SetError` is a lossy 2-field stub:

```rust
// crate-jmap-mail-client/src/methods/mod.rs:90 (and 6 sister crates)
pub struct SetError {
    #[serde(rename = "type")]
    pub error_type: String,
    pub description: Option<String>,
}
```

The server-side `SetError` (jmap-server/src/backend.rs:20) has 8 fields: `error_type`, `description`, `properties`, `existing_id` (RFC 8621 §5.7 `alreadyExists`), `max_recipients` (RFC 8621 §7.5 `tooManyRecipients`), `invalid_recipients` (RFC 8621 §7.5), `not_found` (RFC 8621 §5.5 `blobNotFound`), `max_size` (RFC 8621 §7.5 `tooLarge`).

When a JMAP server returns a SetError with any of these fields populated (a normal case for failed Email/set or EmailSubmission/set calls), the client deserializes into the 2-field struct and silently drops:
- existingId — caller can't determine which existing object caused the collision
- notFound — caller can't tell which blob ids were missing
- maxRecipients / invalidRecipients — caller can't show user the limit / bad addrs
- maxSize — caller can't show the message-size limit

Affected crates: all 7 `crate-jmap-*-client/src/methods/mod.rs`:
- jmap-mail-client
- jmap-chat-client
- jmap-contacts-client
- jmap-calendars-client
- jmap-tasks-client
- jmap-filenode-client
- jmap-sharing-client

Fix options:
1. Add the missing fields to each client crate's SetError. Maintenance hazard (7 crates drift independently).
2. Move SetError to a single shared location — either jmap-types (locked, needs approval) or a new `jmap-base-client::SetError` re-exported by the 7 client crates. PREFERRED.
3. Make the client's SetError generic over a `#[serde(flatten)] extra: serde_json::Value` field to preserve the wire data even when not statically typed. Compromise.

Tied to JMAP-sc1b.X (5 generic response shapes duplicated). Both should be fixed together by promoting RFC 8620 §5 wire shapes to a single home.
title: P1: Client SetError silently drops 6 of 8 RFC 8620 §5.3 fields on deserialize
